description: verdict is your answer: the requirements of the goal you did not see working.

not_seen_working.description: Each requirement of the goal you did not see working. Leave it empty when you saw every one working.

items.description: finding is one requirement you did not see working.

requirement.description: The requirement, quoted word for word from the goal. A finding that quotes nothing in the goal is dropped.

seen.description: What you ran or looked at, and what you saw instead of it working.
